summary_en: This phase 1 study tests a combination of melphalan, BCNU, vitamin B12b, and vitamin C given with the patient's own stem cells, in metastatic pancreatic cancer and metastatic breast cancer. The drugs are given intravenously in 2 cycles, with an autologous stem cell infusion after each cycle, and the vitamin C dose is escalated over time. The study measures the safety of the treatment and is a phase 1 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa una combinación de melfalán, BCNU, vitamina B12b y vitamina C, administrada junto con las propias células madre del paciente, en cáncer de páncreas metastásico y cáncer de mama metastásico. Los medicamentos se administran por vía intravenosa en 2 ciclos, con una infusión de células madre hematopoyéticas autólogas después de cada ciclo, y la dosis de vitamina C aumenta de forma escalonada. El estudio mide la seguridad del tratamiento y es un ensayo de fase 1.
who_for: Stage IV pancreatic cancer or HER2-negative breast cancer.
Expected survival of at least 6 months, as judged by the investigator.
BRCA1, BRCA2, or PALB2 mutation, or at least 16 weeks of first-line platinum chemotherapy without treatment failure.
not_for: Rapid disease progression, as judged by the investigator.
Current cholangitis or biliary tract obstruction.
Known or suspected brain (central nervous system) metastases.
